title: Execution Before Memory: Diagnosing Memory Failures in Video World Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.23542v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A memory test for a video world model should say whether the scene was set, whether the asked change was carried out, and whether the last frame shows the result. Current tests fold these into one number, so a low score is easy to read as forgetting. When the change is not carried out, the hidden state transition cannot appear, so the test is not really a test of memory. We introduce MIST, an evaluation that separates the change from the memory it should leave behind. The model first sets the scene while the change stays hidden, and only later is asked to show it, with leakage before that point kept under control. This separation locates the bottleneck: the model sets the scene but does not carry out the instructed change. The same gap appears in general memory evaluations. On that basis we propose M3-Agent (Make the Missing Move), which recursively revises the details of the input instruction so that the model successfully carries out

translated_title: 执行先于记忆：诊断视频世界模型中的记忆失败
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.23542v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：针对视频世界模型的记忆测试应当回答三个问题：场景是否已被建立、所要求的变更是否已被执行、最后一帧是否呈现了结果。当前的测试将这些方面合并为一个分数，因此低分很容易被解读为“遗忘”。然而当变更未被真正执行时，隐藏状态的转变根本不会发生，此时该测试实际上并非对记忆的真实检验。我们提出了MIST，一种将“变更本身”与“变更应留下的记忆”相分离的评估方法。模型先在变更保持隐藏的情况下建立场景，之后才被要求展示该变更，并且此前的信息泄漏受到严格控制。这种分离方法定位出了瓶颈所在：模型能够建立场景，却没有执行被指示的变更。同样的差距也出现在一般的记忆评估中。基于这一发现，我们提出了M3-Agent（Make the Missing Move，补上缺失的动作），它通过递归地修正输入指令的细节，使模型能够成功执行相应的变更。
tldr: 该论文提出MIST评估框架将“执行指令变更”与“记忆变更结果”分离，揭示视频世界模型记忆测试低分的真正瓶颈是模型未执行指令变更而非遗忘，并据此提出M3-Agent，通过递归修正指令细节使模型成功完成变更。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes MIST, an evaluation that separates the execution of an instructed change from the memory it should leave behind, revealing that low memory scores in video world models stem from failure to execute the change rather than forgetting, and introduces M3-Agent, which recursively revises instruction details so the model successfully carries out the change.
